summary_ja: EuroHPCは2025年12月時点で5方式にまたがる6 quantum computerを調達済みと報告していますが、成熟度はPiast-Q・VLQの開所、Jade・Rubyのquantum simulation、Netherlands・Luxembourgの今後の運用に分かれます。調達台数を一般利用可能なHPC連携service数と解釈せず、方式、設置、開所、利用、scheduler・data連携を別々に追跡します。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: EuroHPC reported six procured quantum computers across five modalities as of December 2025, but maturity differs among the inauguration of Piast-Q and VLQ, the Jade and Ruby quantum simulators, and systems in the Netherlands and Luxembourg still planned for operation. Procurement count is not interpreted as the number of generally accessible HPC-integrated services; modality, installation, inauguration, access, scheduling, and data integration are tracked separately. Consensus is incomplete.

items.name_ja: 6台調達と複数方式、稼働段階は不均一
items.name_en: Six procured systems across modalities with uneven deployment maturity
items.statement_ja: EuroHPC JUはsuperconducting、superconducting-annealing、neutral atom、photonic、trapped-ion方式を含む6 quantum computerを調達済みとしています。そのうちPiast-Q（Poznan）とVLQ（Ostrava）は開所済み、HPCQSのJade（Germany）とRuby（France）はquantum simulatorとして併記され、NetherlandsとLuxembourgの2 systemは今後の運用予定です。調達台数は、一般利用可能台数やHPCと統合したproduction service数ではありません。
items.statement_en: EuroHPC JU reports six procured quantum computers spanning superconducting, superconducting-annealing, neutral-atom, photonic, and trapped-ion technologies. Piast-Q in Poznan and VLQ in Ostrava had been inaugurated; HPCQS Jade in Germany and Ruby in France are listed as quantum simulators; two systems in the Netherlands and Luxembourg were still planned for operation. Procurement count is not the count of generally accessible systems or production services integrated with HPC.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIの量子連携ではqubit数や方式だけでなく、利用資格、queue、SDK、classical resource、data経路、共同予約、error mitigation、結果再現をsystemごとに評価します。
items.hpci_relevance_en: HPCI quantum integration should evaluate eligibility, queues, SDKs, classical resources, data paths, co-reservation, error mitigation, and reproducibility per system rather than only qubit count or modality.
adoption_conditions_ja: QPU、simulator、annealerを同じ台数・性能指標にまとめない。
HPCとのnetwork、identity、scheduler、workflow、利用実績を個別に確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Separate procured, installed, inaugurated, pilot, production, and retired states.
Do not combine QPUs, simulators, and annealers under one count or performance metric.
Verify networking, identity, scheduling, workflows, and use with HPC for each system.
